title: Doors to Darkness — Kingdom Hearts 0: Door to Darkness
note: Each Door exists inside a world and must be sealed. Sealing drives the act-unlock ladder. The final Door is the Archon's throne.

doors.name: The District Keyhole
doors.flavor: The first keyhole. Three districts, one lamp-lit hub.

doors.name: The Drowned Keyhole
doors.flavor: The world that fell first. Where Sora drew the Keyblade in the sand.

doors.name: The Trial Keyhole
doors.flavor: Memory is a crime here. Zero's own memory is fraying.

doors.name: The Arena Keyhole
doors.flavor: Hades whispers the phantom bracket's name.

doors.name: The Temple Keyhole
doors.flavor: The jungle's heart accepts the unknown wielder.

doors.name: The Cave Keyhole
doors.flavor: The lamp chose freedom. Zero leaves a coin.

doors.name: The Belly Keyhole
doors.flavor: The whale sneezes them free. A made heart is still a heart.

doors.name: The Sea Keyhole
doors.flavor: Zero surfaces with salt he never knew he could taste.

doors.name: The Grin Keyhole
doors.flavor: Jack takes his bow. Zero closes the grin before it laughs.

doors.name: The Tower Keyhole
doors.flavor: First trace of Sora. The clockwork sea holds the key.

doors.name: The Page-Eater Keyhole
doors.flavor: The only world with no Keyhole. The Page-Eater is a smudge, not a door.

doors.name: The Bastion Keyhole
doors.flavor: Beating the Machine Heart is beating the narrator of your own story.

doors.name: The Hinge Keyhole
doors.flavor: A door with a cloak, or a cloak shaped like a door. It creaks the old name of the door it serves.

doors.name: The Eye Keyhole
doors.flavor: It sees everything except the one thing Zero hides.

doors.name: The Clockwork Vault Keyhole
doors.flavor: The berserk moon is full. The vault holds the final keyblade fragment.

doors.name: The Chest Keyhole
doors.flavor: Luxord deals from Zero's memories. Win, and it owes more than it can steal.

doors.name: The Door to Darkness
doors.flavor: The final Door. The Archon stole it. Zero is the hinge on the dark side.
